quote: Our son has made such incredible progress since starting at The Hummingbird Nest. He loves going and looks forward to it every week. He has made many friends and learned so many new skills! Tamar and her team run an amazing program and approach each child and each family with respect, empathy, and personalized care. I highly recommend them to any family with neurodiverse kids!
name: Sam

quote: Tamar is the therapist every child deserves. She is wholly attuned to each child’s needs and offers gentle and compassionate suggestions for parents. My kiddos love her and we do too. DIR Floortime changed everything for us.
name: Megan B.

quote: Tamar is phenomenal. I am so glad we connected with her. She has done wonders with my son and has allowed him to reconnect with himself, with others, and with his family. I don’t really know how to express this other than “she gets it, she gets him, and it works.” She brought happiness back to him and to us, and for that I am really grateful.
name: Lauriane Q.

quote: Tamar and Juliana are fantastic! My son enjoyed his 1:1 sessions and Social Group. Definitely check out Hummingbird if your child needs assistance or extra time learning social skills.
name: Gretchen Salo

quote: We had an amazing experience with The Hummingbird Nest, specifically the group our 6 year old was a part of. We joined because he was experiencing several social struggles. His time in the group helped him observe, engage, and react appropriately to different social situations. It was absolutely the right choice for him and our family.
name: Brianne Baird

quote: Undoubtedly the best place to take your child. My children adore our weekly sessions. Tamar is absolutely amazing. This is the best place to take your kids. Hands down!
name: Zachary K.

quote: Tamar and her staff are absolutely wonderful! My son loves it here. They provide useful information that helps children develop great social skills, crucial for a bright future. This is a great program for all children!
name: Suzie M.
